verdict.rationale: Neon's core platform is open source on GitHub and can be compiled and run locally, so the product itself ships a self-hostable codebase. However, the repo frames local runs as 'for small experiments and to test code changes' rather than a supported production self-hosting path. missing for 10: documented production-grade self-hosting/deployment guidance, self-hosted parity for the managed services (Auth, Functions, Object Storage, AI Gateway), independent hands-on corroboration of running a self-hosted Neon in production.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Neon is an open-source serverless Postgres database platform. It separates storage and compute
Neon can be run on a workstation for small experiments and to test code changes
Alternatively, compile and run the project locally.
For us that self-host, the architecture of building cold storage on top of Object Storage and warm storage on top of NVMEs is unbeatable.
